questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: A yield sign tells you to slow down and be ready to stop. You must let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Come to a full stop if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers are on or near the road. Drive slowly and carefully through work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there’s a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign means children may be crossing. Always let pedestrians in crosswalks go first. Stay alert at intersections and when turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay on the right side of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: A Y intersection is ahead. The road splits, so you must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop and wait for traffic and pedestrians to clear before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There are trucks hauling gravel ahead.
The highway ahead is under construction.
The highway ahead is covered with loose gravel.
The highway ahead has been sanded for icy conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is covered with loose gravel.
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you the road ahead has loose gravel. Drive slowly and carefully because your tires will have less grip on gravel.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you lanes are shifting ahead. Be aware and follow the new lane path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you a playground is nearby. Watch for children on or near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign warns you that a flagger is ahead and will direct traffic. Follow the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs warn you that the road curves sharply in the direction the chevron points. In this case, it curves to the left. You may see several chevron signs throughout a curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do at an intersection. It means you can turn right or go straight from that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers to be careful in work zones. This sign tells you that penalties and fines are increased if you drive carelessly in construction areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs indicate railroad crossings. This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Look and listen for oncoming trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Traffic signals arranged vertically have red on top and green on bottom. Signals arranged horizontally have red on the left and green on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that the road shoulder ahead is lower than the main road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves to the right and then to the left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the road curves to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers to be careful in work zones. This sign tells you that workers may be on or near the roadway. Drive with extreme caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safest speed to drive when exiting a highway (in this example, 30 mph).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down at the intersection ahead and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a traffic law sign. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Should maintain your vehicle’s speed until you enter the reduced speed zone.
Should begin to reduce your vehicle’s speed.
Should not slow down because traffic will start to back up.
May reduce your speed, if you choose to do so.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should begin to reduce your vehicle’s speed.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to start slowing down now. The new speed limit will start at the next speed limit sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is a stop sign. Come to a complete stop and look for pedestrians and other vehicles. Only go when the intersection is clear.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that there is a low bridge or overpass ahead. Do not go through if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (in this case, 13 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.
